content.content: When invoked as `deccy new` with valid `--on` ids, the deccy CLI shall print the created node id as exactly one newline-terminated line on stdout and no additional text.
content.rationale: Callers need the created id for later `--on` uses; silence would force them to re-derive it. One plain line keeps the report greppable under O5's line discipline without re-deciding D12's creation steps or O5's channel rules.
